aus.claim: Decision-makers must engage in a full assessment of evidence suggesting Mexico, while willing to protect, may be unable to do so.
aus.limits: This assessment includes the context of the country of origin, steps applicants took, and their interaction with authorities.

evidence.quote: Accordingly, decision-makers must engage in a full assessment of the evidence placed before them suggesting that Mexico, while willing to protect, may be unable to do so.

aus.claim: Madam Justice Gauthier's approach to the presumption of state protection in Mexico is persuasive.

evidence.quote:
[20]
I find Madam Justice Gauthier's approach to the presumption of state protection in Mexico to be persuasive.
